positions.title: FullStack Developer
positions.description: Development and evolution of new products using CQRS architecture with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework on the back-end, and TypeScript, Angular, and Syncfusion components on the front-end. Maintenance and support for legacy systems with technologies like ASP.NET MVC and Ext JS.

positions.title: CTO / Developer and Co-Founder
positions.description: Planning and defining architecture ensuring scalability, security, and high availability. Modeling and implementing PostgreSQL database including diagramming and query optimization. Process automation with CI/CD for continuous integration and delivery. Backend development with .NET applying SOLID principles and Clean Architecture. Frontend development with ReactJS and Tailwind for responsive and high-performance interfaces. Technical leadership and strategic decisions aligned with business goals.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description: Technical leadership of the development team, focusing on scalable and sustainable architecture definition, code review, mentorship, and technical support to developers. Responsible for technology choices, managing the CI/CD pipeline with Azure, implementing automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E), and promoting best development practices. Leading technical meetings, workshops, risk assessment, and facilitating communication between teams. Strategic role to ensure scalability, performance, and alignment with business objectives. Temporarily took over coordination during formal leadership absence.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description: Development of scalable and high-performance systems and microservices. Implementation and maintenance of frontend interfaces using CSHTML, JavaScript, and MVC architecture. Creation, optimization, and securing REST APIs. Working with .NET, C#, SQL Server, MongoDB, and agile methodologies. Applying SOLID principles, Clean Code, and design patterns (Builder, Strategy, Factory, Singleton, Iterator). Using RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication between microservices and Elasticsearch for logging and monitoring. Implementing unit tests to ensure code quality.
